## Evidence warning

The current Portuguese narrative distinguishes observed starting conditions from future scenario events in its notes and sources. It is a scenario, not a prediction. The earlier English edition retains two branches and must not be treated as the current translation. REDATA and supporting policy pages retain their own review dates.
